steps.note: The loop procedure: brief → patch one item at a time inside the write set → run-verify → advance. View it; do not view story-era pom skills (pilot v5: whole-pom rewrite). Per-kind reference skills are named in the card body and viewed only when the brief's advice is not enough.

The head cluster's brief: every item with its advice, the pom element at the line, advised artifacts already present / unmanaged by the BOM with the managed equivalent, compiler diagnostics with inventory hits, property mappings. The brief is the plan; nothing else is.

The real tools on the candidate. Default --mode acceptance (online warm-up, then offline JDK diagnostics, surefire, MTA rescan, packaging/startup when green). --mode diagnostic is not an acceptance pass. exit 1 is a tool failure (re-run or kanban_block), never a verdict.

The acceptance transaction. ACCEPTED commits and mints the next card; REVERTED discards the candidate and re-mints this cluster; VERIFICATION_PENDING retains the candidate without counting an attempt; DEFERRED stops the loop. REVERTED/DEFERRED/PENDING exit 1 by design: the grade is the loop record naming this card as accepted or rejected, not the exit code. PENDING is kanban_block, not complete.
